offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures electro-optic auto-dimming mirrors, driver-monitoring cameras, dimmable aircraft windows and smoke alarms. Sells mainly to automakers and aircraft manufacturers, delivered from its own factories.

primary_products.value: auto-dimming rearview mirrors; exterior mirrors; driver-monitoring camera systems; dimmable aircraft windows; smoke alarms

customer_segment.value: B2B: automakers and their suppliers, aircraft manufacturers, building and fire-safety equipment makers

end_markets.value: automotive; aerospace; fire safety; building construction

revenue_model.value: product sales: electro-optic mirrors, camera modules, dimmable windows and alarms sold to manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds electro-optic modules and mirrors from purchased glass and electronics, sold to automakers and aircraft makers

geography_served.value: global: automaker plants in North America, Europe and Asia, plus aircraft makers worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: auto-dimming mirrors, driver-monitoring cameras, aircraft windows and fire detection, sharing electro-optic technology and automotive customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales to automakers and aircraft manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: automotive safety standards and aviation certification requirements for aircraft parts and fire alarm standards
